records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Owen,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

Good to talk on our welcome call last week, and glad the notification badge issue Tariq looked at is sorted -- that ticket is closed now, so do tell me if it reappears.

When you're ready, the natural next step is your first project: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Nadia
